contea di ritrovamento: East Sussex (Inghilterra e Galles)
D/ CNVT REX ANG ; R/ DVNSTAN ON LVN

An Early Medieval silver penny of Cnut (AD1024-1030). Moneyer: Dunstan of London. North no. 787. Obverse: Bust left wearing pointed helmet; in front, sceptre with a trefoil head Obverse inscription: CNVT REX ANG Reverse: Short cross voided, limbs united at base by two circles; in centre: a pellet; in each angle: a broken annulet enclosing a pellet. Reverse inscription: DVNSTAN ON LVN Die axis…
